name: @humblehire/docs-assets
description: CLI harness that drives the HumbleHire app to regenerate documentation screenshots and GIFs.

scripts.generate: tsx src/cli.ts generate --out docs/assets --fps 10 --colors 96 --width 900 --dither bayer --bayer-scale 3 --port 4888 --themes light,dark --scale 2 --timeout 120000
